explanation: The problem of which orders n admit a complete set of n − 1 mutually orthogonal Latin squares (equivalently an affine plane of order n), cf. Wikipedia 'Problems in Latin squares' and Wanless's survey. The formal statement sets the answer equal to {n | HasCompleteMOLS n}, with HasCompleteMOLS requiring 0 < n and n − 1 pairwise orthogonal squares (Orthogonal is injectivity of the superposition map). n = 1 is vacuously included, which is the standard convention (a degenerate plane). A faithful 'determine the set' formulation.
